prompt:
Cut-out (src/v2/cut.py: rembg isnet + green-ground mask, baked contact shadow) of this Google Flow nano-2.1 image, project Konso Website v2:

Keep this exact dish and crockery from the reference photo: a cream plate with a dark green rim piled with crisp double-fried chicken tossed in a glossy dark green-chilli sauce, lots of sliced fresh green chillies and spring onion, smoky wok char on the edges. Low-key studio food photograph for a luxury restaurant website. The dish sits alone, centred, on a plain flat seamless deep bottle-green background (#0B2A14), nothing else in frame: no table, no wood, no cloth, no cutlery, no props, no text, no logo. Camera low, about 25 degrees above the surface, like a product shot of an object standing on a catwalk, so the vessel and the food piled in it are both clearly visible; a soft natural contact shadow directly under the vessel. One warm golden key light from the upper left with soft fill, crisp specular highlights on glossy sauce, the food in rich, saturated, true-to-life colours that pop against the dark green: vivid chilli red, fresh bright green herbs and spring onion, golden crisp edges, gentle wisps of steam where the food is hot. Ultra sharp, 100 mm macro lens, everything in focus. The whole vessel sits fully inside the frame with a generous empty margin on all four sides, never cropped. Each item appears exactly once. Photoreal, appetising, editorial.
